defaults.source: This study stage 5 local longitudinal R1-R5 increment
defaults.rationale: Declared development hypothesis. Inherit all phase4 hard, comfort, prediction, sensing and actuator bounds unchanged; no hidden types, shared schedule or global slots.

parameters.name: formation_reference_rule
parameters.rationale: Predeclared B1 if/else comparison: retain current visible forward reference; otherwise nearest same-lane front (30m), then nearest forward adjacent corner (15m). B2 corner_first only reverses the two new-reference groups; exact ambiguity exits. No global slots, ID priority, side/rear reference or safety limit change.

parameters.name: formation_d_ref_m
parameters.rationale: Adjacent-lane phase offset; same-lane target reference spacing is exactly twice this value, 30m.

parameters.name: formation_lane_change_cooldown_s
parameters.rationale: Formation activation cooldown after own NOA lane change; phase4 maneuver policy stays unchanged.

parameters.name: formation_position_tolerance_m
parameters.rationale: Local-state label and conflict normalization, not independent group detection.

parameters.name: formation_maintaining_speed_tolerance_mps
parameters.rationale: Own state label only; never substitutes for offline formation detection.

parameters.name: formation_switch_cost
parameters.rationale: Dimensionless holding preference in geometric/relative-speed/residual score; no label rank.
